proposal.title: Underline inline links in legal/body copy
proposal.rationale: axe link-in-text-block fires on register (2), privacy (3), terms (4), and support (1). shots/web.public.register.png confirms it visually: 'Terms of Service' and 'Privacy Policy' in the signup consent line are distinguished from surrounding black text only by green color, with no underline or other affordance.
proposal.change: Add an underline (or other non-color affordance, e.g. weight) to inline text links wherever they sit inside a sentence of body copy — the register consent line and the privacy/terms/support page bodies — so they're distinguishable without relying on color alone.

proposal.title: Auto-draft a reteach mini-lesson alongside the practice set
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day as giving 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' but the only concrete generation capability listed is more practice problems (Generation, Practice) — there's no described artifact for the reteach moment itself, i.e. what the teacher actually says/shows at the board.
proposal.change: When a concept is flagged as a class-wide weak spot, generate a short AI-drafted reteach card (a compact re-explanation plus one worked example, produced by the same verified generation pipeline used for problem sets) that the teacher can review/edit and project to open class, alongside the existing one-click practice set.

proposal.title: Fix CORS block that takes down the entire admin dashboard
proposal.rationale: All 5 admin surfaces log an identical console error: "Access to fetch at 'http://localhost:8000/v1/admin/...' from origin 'http://localhost:5173' has been blocked by CORS policy: ... No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present" plus a net::ERR_FAILED. shots/admin.leads.png confirms the visible effect: a full-width red "No response from the backend" banner and a "Couldn't load this view. / Can't reach our servers right now." empty state instead of any data — the whole admin app (leads, schools, quality, harness runs, LLM calls) is unusable, not just missing a few fields.

proposal.title: One-click reteach pack generated from the class's top missed concept
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics as already identifying "which concepts the class is missing" and wanting "a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set," but the feature map lists only assignment/question-bank generation from a worksheet or topic — there's no shortcut from a diagnosed weak concept straight to an assignable reteach set.
proposal.change: On the teacher analytics/class-insight view, add a button next to a flagged weak concept that calls the existing generation pipeline (assignment_generation.py) pre-seeded with that concept, producing a short worked-example + practice set draft the teacher reviews and assigns in one flow — reusing existing generation/verification, not a new AI capability.

proposal.title: Let a student flag "I don't get this" during practice, surfaced to the teacher to-do list
proposal.rationale: The integrity check only probes understanding after a submission is graded, and teacher-day analytics surface struggle from grade/error patterns (weak_spots.py). Neither captures a student who got the right answer but knows they're shaky, or who is stuck mid-practice — a lightweight self-report would feed the same "students who need help first" list with a signal the AI loop can't infer on its own.
proposal.change: Add a small "I'm not sure about this one" toggle on the practice/homework submission UI that writes a lightweight flag alongside the submission, surfaced on the teacher's to-do list ranking next to AI-detected struggle signals.

proposal.title: One-click reteach follow-up from a low-confidence integrity flag
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes the integrity check as emitting per-problem badges/confidence/verdict for the teacher to review, and separately describes a class-wide 'see the gap, fix it in one click' practice action — but the two aren't connected: a teacher who sees a single student flagged with low understanding confidence has no direct action from that flag to a targeted follow-up for just that student.
proposal.change: On the grade review page, when a submission's integrity verdict shows low confidence, add a 'Send a follow-up practice problem' action next to the badge that generates one targeted problem on that specific concept for that student — closing the loop from flag to reteach at the individual level, distinct from the existing class-wide practice-set generation.

proposal.title: Give students a short recap after the understanding-check conversation
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes the integrity conversation as a screening gate feeding badges/reasoning to the teacher, with every turn stored for audit — but nothing in the feature map gives the student a takeaway from their own conversation, even though 'tutoring guides, never gives answers' is a stated principle for Learn mode.
proposal.change: After the integrity chat ends, show the student a short, non-graded recap ('here's what a full explanation of this step looks like') generated from their own conversation, turning the check into a learning moment rather than only a teacher-facing screening signal.

proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's origin to the API's CORS allowlist
proposal.rationale: All 5 admin surfaces fail identically: console shows 'blocked by CORS policy: ... No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header' for every /v1/admin/* fetch from localhost:5173, and each screenshot renders the sitewide 'Couldn't load this view / API unreachable' error state instead of real data (see shots/admin.leads.png). Traced root cause in api/config.py:47-53 (cors_origins default) and api/middleware/setup.py:29-36 (CORSMiddleware setup): the allowlist only contains localhost:8081, localhost:3000, veradicai.com, and a vercel.app regex scoped to the 'web' app's deployment — localhost:5173 (Vite's default port, used by dashboard/) is absent from both the static list and the regex, and dashboard/vercel.json has no custom domain, so its actual deployed Vercel origin likely doesn't match the regex either. This is not just a local dev gap; the deployed admin dashboard is plausibly CORS-blocked too.
proposal.change: Add http://localhost:5173 to the default cors_origins list in api/config.py, and add the dashboard's real deployed origin (or a regex covering its Vercel preview/prod URLs, following the existing math-teacher-app-eight pattern) alongside the existing web-app regex. Update .env.example's CORS_ORIGINS comment to mention the dashboard port.

proposal.title: Auto-draft a targeted reteach set from teacher-day struggle signals
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day as surfacing 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' and generation already re-derives/verifies answers before trusting output (api/core/assignment_generation.py) — but the map doesn't show these two connected: today the teacher still has to manually turn a surfaced concept-gap into an assignment. This is a gap in closing the loop, not a duplicate of existing generation or analytics features.
proposal.change: From the class-analytics 'concept the class is missing' card, add a one-click action that calls the existing generation pipeline pre-scoped to that exact concept (and, where relevant, the specific students the integrity check flagged) and returns a ready-to-review mini practice set the teacher can edit and assign in one step, instead of starting a generation job from scratch.

proposal.title: Notify students when a teacher edits their AI-drafted grade
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md states grading 'pre-fills the teacher's review page' and the teacher approves/edits every grade, and integrity 'raises scrutiny, never auto-flags' — but the feature map has no student-facing signal when a teacher's edit changes the AI's original grade or reasoning. Closing that loop back to the student (not just teacher-side audit) reinforces the understanding-check goal without adding a general messaging system.
proposal.change: When a teacher edits an AI-drafted grade or integrity verdict before publishing, surface a short student-facing note on that problem's receipt (e.g. 'Your teacher adjusted this — see their note') alongside the existing grade explanation, using the same submission-grade record rather than a new messaging channel.

proposal.title: Give inline text links a static non-color affordance (underline), not hover-only
proposal.rationale: Axe flags 'Links must be distinguishable without relying on color' on register (2), privacy (3), terms (4), and support (1) — all high severity. The register screenshot shows exactly this: 'By signing up, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' renders the two links in green with no underline, indistinguishable from styled body text for anyone who can't rely on color. Confirmed in code: every flagged link uses the identical `className="text-primary hover:underline"` pattern with no static underline — `web/src/app/register/page.tsx:474-479` (Terms of Service / Privacy Policy links) and `:488-493` (Sign In link, which has no underline class at all, not even on hover); the legal pages bake the same `class="text-primary hover:underline"` string into their HTML `content` fields rendered via `web/src/components/landing/legal-page.tsx` (e.g. `privacy/page.tsx:71,109,118,143-144`, `terms/page.tsx:155,157,165,194,203-204`); and `support/page.tsx:38-40,67-70,96` follow the same convention. It's one repeated convention, not a shared component, so it needs a find-and-replace rather than a single fix point.
proposal.change: Replace `hover:underline` with a static `underline` (or `underline decoration-primary/40 hover:decoration-primary` for a softer default look) on the four flagged surfaces' inline text links, so links are visibly distinct before any interaction.

proposal.title: Cross-section concept-mastery rollup for teachers running multiple sections of one course
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md's teacher-day description frames the value as 'analytics on which students are slipping and which concepts the class is missing,' and the feature map lists practice-activity analytics as per-section. A teacher running several sections of the same course (a common real setup, per the courses/units/sections model in section 4) has no described way to see 'which concept is weakest across all my sections of Algebra II' at a glance — they'd have to check each section's analytics separately and mentally aggregate, which undercuts the 'walk in already knowing' promise at the course level.
proposal.change: Add a course-level rollup view (alongside the existing per-section teacher-grades/practice-activity analytics) that aggregates concept-mastery and struggling-student signals across all of a teacher's sections for the same course.

proposal.title: Underline inline text links by default instead of only on hover
proposal.rationale: Axe's link-in-text-block rule fires on register (2), privacy (3), terms (4), and support (1) — links embedded in body copy are distinguished from surrounding text by color alone. Confirmed in code: web/src/app/register/page.tsx:474-479 ('Terms of Service' / 'Privacy Policy') and every inline link in web/src/app/(legal)/privacy/page.tsx and web/src/app/(legal)/terms/page.tsx use `class="text-primary hover:underline"` — underline is hover-only, so the resting state relies purely on the green text color against surrounding black/gray body text, which fails for colorblind users and anyone not hovering.
proposal.change: Change the repeated `text-primary hover:underline` class pattern on inline body-text links (register's ToS/Privacy links, and the mailto:/cross-links in the privacy, terms, and support pages) to underline by default (e.g. `underline decoration-primary/40 hover:decoration-primary`), keeping hover as a visual reinforcement rather than the only cue.

proposal.title: Let a student ask one follow-up question about a specific graded problem
proposal.rationale: Grading (api/core/grading_ai.py) already produces a per-problem written justification ('receipt') and Integrity already runs a real one-on-one conversational check (api/core/integrity_ai.py) — the infrastructure for a short guided chat tied to one problem already exists. But once a grade is posted, a student who doesn't understand why a problem was marked wrong has no way to ask beyond going to the teacher directly; there's no student-initiated clarification thread anchored to a grade receipt.
proposal.change: Add a small 'Ask about this' affordance on a graded problem that opens a single-turn (or short, capped) tutoring-style chat scoped to that problem's receipt — it can explain the existing reasoning and point at the relevant step, but per the tutoring-guides-not-answers principle it must not change the grade or hand over the next problem's answer.

proposal.title: Track whether a flagged weak spot has since been resolved
proposal.rationale: api/routes/weak_spots.py returns a flat list of every problem where has_issues=true, deduped by problem text with an issue_count, but there's no notion of a weak spot being 'resolved' — a student who later nails several similar practice problems still sees the same old flagged item with no signal that they've since improved, which undercuts the Review tab's value as a workspace for what's still actually weak.
proposal.change: When a student succeeds on practice problems generated from a flagged weak spot's concept, mark the original weak-spot item resolved (or show a small 'improving' trend) in the weak-spots response, so Review surfaces what's still open instead of accumulating every past miss forever.

proposal.title: Show concept mastery trend over time, not just a current snapshot
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics as surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' per the current assignment/section, but doesn't describe a longitudinal view of whether a specific concept is improving or stalling across assignments over the term. Without a trend, a teacher can't tell whether last week's reteach actually worked or the same students are still stuck on the same concept.
proposal.change: Add a per-class, per-concept trend line (e.g. % mastery or error rate by assignment date) to the teacher analytics view, built from existing grading + weak-spots data already captured per submission — no new data collection, just a longitudinal aggregation and chart on top of what's already stored.

proposal.title: One-click generate a mini-lesson targeted at the exact misconception flagged
proposal.rationale: The product already surfaces specific error patterns (e.g. 'sign error — moved -6 across on the third line but kept it negative', visible in the demo.present screenshot's grading example) and already has a generic 'practice set' reteach path. But the gap is between 'we found the exact misconception' and 'the student gets a lesson about that exact misconception' — today's practice path re-generates similar problems, not a short targeted explanation of the specific mistake.
proposal.change: When grading or the integrity check identifies a specific, named misconception (e.g. sign error, distribution error) shared by multiple students, let the teacher one-click generate a short worked-example mini-lesson targeted at that exact misconception (reusing the existing generation/answer-verification pipeline) to assign alongside or before the practice set.

proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's origin to the API's CORS allow-list
proposal.rationale: Every admin surface logs a CORS preflight failure in console_errors ("Access to fetch ... has been blocked by CORS policy: ... No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header") and the admin.leads screenshot shows the resulting broken state full-page: a red 'No response from the backend' banner plus a 'Couldn't load this view / API unreachable' empty state instead of any lead data. `api/config.py:47-53` hardcodes `cors_origins` to `localhost:8081`, `localhost:3000`, `veradicai.com`/`www.veradicai.com`, and the Vercel preview URL — the admin dashboard's dev/preview origin (`http://localhost:5173`, per `.github/workflows/improver-scan.yml:51`) is absent, so the browser blocks every admin API call before it leaves the client. This isn't a transient outage; it's a fixed, reproducible misconfiguration and it silently breaks the entire ops/sales dashboard (leads, schools, quality, harness runs, LLM calls all show the identical failure).
proposal.change: Add the admin dashboard's origin(s) to `cors_origins` in `api/config.py:47` (and confirm the deployed admin dashboard's real domain is also covered, not just localhost) so preflight requests succeed and the five admin views render live data instead of the unreachable-backend empty state.

proposal.title: Show a class's concept-mastery trend across assignments, not just a snapshot
proposal.rationale: The teacher-day loop (per PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md) surfaces 'which students are slipping and which concepts the class is missing' and lets a teacher go from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set in one click — but that's described as a point-in-time view of the current assignment/section, not a longitudinal one. There's no described way for a teacher to see whether a concept the class struggled with two weeks ago actually improved after the reteach.
proposal.change: Add a per-concept trend view on the teacher analytics surface (`api/routes/teacher_practice_activity.py` / practice-activity analytics) plotting mastery over the last N assignments, so a teacher can confirm a reteach worked instead of only seeing the latest snapshot.

proposal.title: Schedule spaced-repetition nudges from a student's weak spots
proposal.rationale: Weak Spots/Review (`api/routes/weak_spots.py`, mobile `WeakSpotsScreen`) surfaces recurring error patterns for a student to revisit, per PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md — but nothing in the feature map schedules *when* to revisit them. Spaced repetition (review right before the forgetting curve dips) is a well-established, low-risk way to make that existing surface actually stick, and it stays entirely inside the practice/review loop rather than adding LMS-style scope.
proposal.change: Use the existing weak-spot error-pattern data to schedule practice nudges at increasing intervals (e.g. 1/3/7/14 days) instead of leaving weak-spot review purely opt-in/unscheduled, surfaced as a lightweight reminder in the student's self-study home.

proposal.title: One-click turn a class-wide weak concept into a targeted mini re-lesson
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' and 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' but the concrete mechanism described is generating more practice problems, not a short re-teaching explainer. Learn mode already decomposes problems into ordered teachable steps (step_decomposition.py) -- that machinery isn't described as being triggered directly from a class-level weak-concept signal to the specific subset of students who need it.
proposal.change: From the teacher analytics view where a missed concept is surfaced, add an action that generates a short Learn-mode mini-lesson for that concept and auto-assigns it only to the students who missed it, closing the loop from 'class is missing X' to 'those students get a guided re-teach' in one click.

proposal.title: Surface recurring (not just one-off) integrity concerns in the teacher to-do list
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md says every integrity check turn is stored for audit and the teacher-day view opens to 'a to-do list, not a scoreboard' ranking students who need attention first, but the ranking signal described is per-submission (badges/confidence per check), not a cross-assignment pattern. A student who fails the understanding check once is very different from one who fails it every week -- the latter is a much stronger signal a teacher should see first.
proposal.change: Aggregate a student's integrity-check verdicts across their recent submissions and boost/label repeat-pattern students distinctly from one-off flags in the teacher's ranked to-do list, using data already captured in api/models/integrity_check.py without adding a new subsystem.

proposal.title: Turn a class-level concept gap into a one-click verified reteach set
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' and generation already re-derives/verifies every answer before a teacher sees it, but the feature map doesn't show a direct action wiring a detected class-wide concept gap straight into the existing verified-generation pipeline at the class (not per-student) level.
proposal.change: When teacher-day analytics surface a concept most of the class is missing, add a single action next to that insight that runs the existing generation pipeline to draft a short, answer-verified reteach set for that concept, pre-filled for the teacher to review and assign to the whole class.

proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's dev origin to the API's CORS allow-list
proposal.rationale: All 5 admin surfaces show identical console errors: 'Access to fetch ... from origin http://localhost:5173 has been blocked by CORS policy: ... No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header'. The admin.leads screenshot confirms the visible effect: every view renders 'Couldn't load this view. Can't reach our servers right now.' with only a Retry button — the entire admin app is non-functional. Root cause traced to code: api/config.py:47-53 defines `cors_origins` with `http://localhost:8081` (mobile/Expo) and `http://localhost:3000` (web) but never `http://localhost:5173`, which is the Vite dev-server port the dashboard app (dashboard/) runs on.
proposal.change: Add "http://localhost:5173" to the `cors_origins` default list in api/config.py:47-53, alongside the existing localhost dev entries, so the admin dashboard's fetches to the API pass CORS preflight in local/dev environments.

proposal.title: Give students a short recap after their understanding-check conversation
proposal.rationale: The integrity understanding-check (api/core/integrity_ai.py) produces a verdict/reasoning that today is teacher-facing only (per the feature map, it feeds grade review). The student who just spent a turn explaining their steps gets no closing feedback of their own — a missed moment to reinforce the exact concept the check surfaced, on the student side of the same loop.
proposal.change: After the understanding-check conversation ends, show the student a one-line, non-graded recap (e.g. 'You explained step 2 clearly but weren't sure why you flipped the inequality — that's worth reviewing') derived from the same reasoning already generated for the teacher, surfaced in the student's submission view.

proposal.title: Show whether a concept improved after the teacher assigned a reteach/practice set
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics as surfacing 'which students are slipping and which concepts the class is missing' and a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set (api/routes/teacher_practice_activity.py, practice_activity.py), but the feature map stops at assigning the reteach — there's no described feedback loop showing whether it worked.
proposal.change: On the teacher analytics view, when a concept-gap-driven practice set has been assigned, show a small before/after indicator (e.g., class accuracy on that concept pre- vs post-practice) using existing practice_activity data, so the reteach loop closes with a visible outcome instead of ending at 'assigned.'

proposal.title: Fix the demo app's /present/* deep-dive URLs — they silently redirect to the hub
proposal.rationale: shots/demo.present.png, demo.present_integrity.png, demo.present_grading.png, demo.present_generation.png and demo.present_teacher_day.png are pixel-identical to shots/demo.hub.png (file sizes within 0.006% of each other, 2348712-2348836 bytes, and visibly the same hub page on inspection) even though they're meant to be four distinct deep-dive stories. Root cause in code: demo/src/App.tsx defines the story routes at /integrity, /grading, /generation, /teacher-day with no '/present' prefix (confirmed by DemoHub.tsx:62's own internal link, to={`/${card.key}`}), so a direct visit to /present or /present/grading matches nothing and falls through to the catch-all `<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}>` (App.tsx:65), bouncing straight back to the hub. This is what the improver's own surfaces catalog (tests/harness/improver/surfaces.py:92-96) requests, so all 4 sales-demo stories have gone unverified by every evidence run so far.
proposal.change: Update tests/harness/improver/surfaces.py:92-96 to the real paths (/integrity, /grading, /generation, /teacher-day) so evidence runs actually inspect the 4 story pages instead of re-screenshotting the hub. If '/present/*' is meant to be an externally shareable URL for sales reps (PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes 'present mode (/present)'), add matching routes in demo/src/App.tsx instead/also — confirm which with the team before choosing, since only the catalog fix is needed to unblock future evidence coverage.

proposal.title: Feed classroom homework mistakes into a student's Weak Spots review, not just self-study ones
proposal.rationale: api/routes/weak_spots.py joins WorkSubmission to Session (self-study) only — its own docstring says results are 'subject-filtered via the parent session' — and grep finds no weak-spot integration in api/routes/school_student_practice.py or teacher_practice_activity.py. So a school student who struggles on assigned classroom homework (graded via SubmissionGrade, not a self-study Session) never sees those mistakes surface in their own Review tab — only problems they hit during independent Learn/Practice/Mock-test sessions do, even though the teacher-side analytics already track classroom struggle signals per PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md sec 3.
proposal.change: Extend the weak-spots query (or add a parallel one) to also pull flagged/low-scoring problems from a school student's graded classroom WorkSubmissions, so their personal Review tab reflects everything they've struggled with — assigned homework and self-study alike — not just the self-study half.

proposal.title: Prompt the student to retake a photo when homework extraction is unreadable
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md notes a submission the integrity check can't read is marked skipped_unreadable rather than penalized — but the feature map's submission flow (photo -> extraction confirm -> grade) has no described corrective loop back to the student when that happens, so an unreadable page currently just falls out of grading silently instead of being fixed at the source.
proposal.change: When extraction confidence is low or a page is marked unreadable, surface an in-app prompt on the student's submission detail telling them which page/problem was unreadable and offering a one-tap retake-photo action that re-triggers extraction for just that page.

proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's local dev origin to the API's CORS allowlist
proposal.rationale: Console errors on all 5 admin surfaces: "Access to fetch at 'http://localhost:8000/...' from origin 'http://localhost:5173' has been blocked by CORS policy" plus net::ERR_FAILED. The admin.leads screenshot confirms the visible effect: the whole Leads page renders only "Couldn't load this view / Can't reach our servers right now" with a red API UNREACHABLE badge in the sidebar. Root cause confirmed in code: api/config.py:47-53 hardcodes cors_origins to localhost:8081, localhost:3000, and two prod domains, but never localhost:5173 — the dashboard app's Vite dev port (dashboard/ is a separate Vite app from web/). Every admin route that calls the API is unusable against a local backend.
proposal.change: Add "http://localhost:5173" (and 127.0.0.1:5173 if the dashboard's dev server binds there) to the default cors_origins list in api/config.py:47-53, alongside the existing localhost:8081/3000 entries.

proposal.title: Turn the review page's "needs practice" flag into a one-click per-student assignment
proposal.rationale: In the section review page, a submission can be pilled needs_practice ("Got the right answer mechanically but couldn't show why it works" — review/page.tsx:4649) but a code comment right above confirms it's descriptive only: it "never enqueues it (school_student_practice), so no grade is on..." (review/page.tsx:1987). The class-level struggle panel already has a reteach flow (PracticeStrugglePanel -> NewPracticeModal, pre-seeded by concept) for aggregate/anonymous struggle, but there's no equivalent one-click action to assign that same student targeted practice on that concept at the moment the teacher is looking at their individual flagged submission — the teacher-day loop (grade -> understand -> reteach) stops at "see the flag" for the individual case.
proposal.change: Add a small "Assign practice on this" action next to the needs_practice pill on the review page, wired to the same per-assignment practice enqueue path (school_student_practice) the class-level modal uses, pre-seeded with the concept and scoped to just that student.

proposal.title: Let students revisit their own past understanding-check conversations
proposal.rationale: Every integrity conversation turn is stored for audit, but the feature map's student-facing surfaces only include a weak-spots pattern screen and history list/detail — there's no student view that reopens a past understanding-check chat to see what they couldn't explain last time.
proposal.change: Add a 'Review understanding checks' entry to the student's History/Review surface that replays a past submission's integrity conversation read-only alongside its grade, so students can learn from a prior struggle instead of only seeing the verdict.

proposal.title: Auto-surface a one-click reteach set when class analytics flag a concept
proposal.rationale: Teacher-day analytics already rank which concepts the class is missing, and Generation can already build a verified problem set from a topic — but per the feature map, connecting a struggle signal to a practice set is a manual, teacher-initiated step today, not a wired-together path.
proposal.change: When teacher-day analytics flag a concept a threshold share of the class is missing, add an inline 'Generate reteach set for [concept]' action in that analytics view that calls the existing generation pipeline pre-filled with the concept, instead of requiring the teacher to start a generation job from scratch.

proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's dev origin to the API's CORS allowlist
proposal.rationale: All 5 admin surfaces load with console errors 'blocked by CORS policy: ... No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header' for every fetch to http://localhost:8000/v1/admin/*, and the screenshots confirm the dashboard is fully dead ('No response from the backend' banner, 'Couldn't load this view.', 'API UNREACHABLE'). Root cause traced in code: api/config.py:47-53 hardcodes cors_origins to [localhost:8081, localhost:3000, veradicai.com, www.veradicai.com, math-teacher-app-eight.vercel.app] — the admin dashboard's Vite dev server origin (http://localhost:5173, per the URLs in findings.json) is simply missing from the list, so every request from it is rejected at the CORS layer before it reaches a route.
proposal.change: Add "http://localhost:5173" to the cors_origins default list in api/config.py:47-53 (and confirm the deployed admin dashboard's prod origin is also present, or covered by an env override) so the admin app's preflight requests succeed. This is a one-line allowlist fix, not a workaround — every admin page is otherwise unusable.

proposal.title: Give students a short takeaway after the integrity understanding-check conversation
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md documents that the integrity check emits badges/confidence/reasoning for the teacher, but describes nothing shown back to the student once their one-on-one conversation ends — the loop closes at the teacher's review, not at the student's own learning moment.

proposal.title: Add a one-click 'reteach explainer' generated from the class's top missed concept

proposal.change: From the teacher-day 'concept the class is missing' signal, add a button that generates a short (verified, re-derived like other Generation output) worked-example explainer for that concept — distinct from a practice set — ready to project to the class or assign standalone.

proposal.title: One-click 'generate reteach set' from a teacher-day weak-concept signal
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' and 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' and separately describes Generation as a distinct worksheet/topic-driven flow (`assignment_generation.py`) — but there's no described action that pre-seeds a Generation job directly from an analytics-identified weak concept, closing the loop the product's own diagram (homework -> grade -> understand -> reteach) implies.
proposal.change: On the teacher-day/analytics view, add a 'Generate reteach set' action next to each flagged weak concept that opens the existing generation flow pre-filled with that concept as the topic, instead of the teacher re-typing/re-selecting it from scratch.

proposal.title: Surface a per-student 'assign practice on this' action inline in grade review
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md's Practice capability supports assignment-tied practice for school students, and Weak spots surfaces 'a student's recurring error patterns,' but both are described as separate views the teacher must navigate to — grade review (where the teacher already sees which problem/skill a student missed) has no described one-click hand-off into targeted practice for that specific student and skill.
proposal.change: In the per-student grade review row, when a problem is marked wrong or integrity-flagged, add an inline 'Assign practice on this' button that creates a targeted practice set for that student on that skill, without leaving the grade review screen.

proposal.title: Sort the teacher's grade-review queue by AI grading confidence, lowest first
proposal.rationale: Product context (PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md principle: 'the teacher sees every AI grade... it is a draft, not an auto-posted score') means teachers must review every submission regardless of AI confidence, but the review UI (teacher_grades.py) has no described mechanism for prioritizing that review — a teacher currently has no way to spend their limited review time on the grades the AI is least sure about first.
proposal.change: Surface the AI's per-problem grading confidence (already computed for grading) as a sort/filter on the section grade-review list, defaulting to lowest-confidence-first, so a teacher who can't review every problem in depth still catches the ones most likely to need a correction.

proposal.title: One-click 'assign reteach practice' from a surfaced class concept gap
proposal.rationale: The teacher-day story explicitly promises 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' and analytics already surface which concepts the class is missing (teacher_practice_activity.py, practice_activity.py), but closing the loop today still requires the teacher to manually open question-bank generation and configure a new set — there's no single action that turns 'the class missed distributive property' directly into an assigned practice set for exactly that concept.
proposal.change: On the teacher-day analytics view, add a one-click action next to each surfaced concept gap ('X students missed distributive property') that pre-fills and immediately generates+assigns a targeted reteach practice set for that concept to the affected students, reusing the existing generation/verification pipeline instead of a fresh manual generation flow.

proposal.title: Give each admin dashboard page a real in-content h1
proposal.rationale: axe page-has-heading-one flags all five admin pages checked (Leads, Schools, Quality, Harness runs, LLM calls). In the screenshots the only differentiator between pages is the bolded sidebar nav item ('Leads', etc.) — there's no page-level heading in the content pane itself.

proposal.title: Surface a per-student understanding-check trend, not just one submission at a time
proposal.rationale: The integrity pipeline emits a badge/verdict per submission and teacher-day surfaces a ranked to-do list of students who need attention, but per the feature map there's no view of one student's understanding-check pattern across assignments — a teacher currently has to notice a repeat pattern by remembering past submissions.
proposal.change: Add a small trend indicator (e.g. last 5 integrity verdicts as dots) to each student's row in the teacher-day to-do/analytics view, so a student who repeatedly can't explain their own steps stands out over time instead of only on the one flagged submission.

proposal.title: Generate a short reteach explainer, not just more practice, for concepts the class is missing
proposal.rationale: The teacher-day 'fix the gap in one click' step (demo.hub screenshot, step 5) currently generates a practice set for the concept the class is missing, but the product's own named loop is 'homework -> grade -> understand -> reteach' — there's no generated re-explanation content, only more problems to solve after the gap is found.
proposal.change: Next to the existing one-click practice-set generation on the concept-gap card, add a one-click 'generate a short reteach explainer' that reuses the Learn mode's step-decomposition engine to produce a 3-step re-explanation of the missed concept, which the teacher can review and present.

proposal.title: One-click class-level reteach pack from teacher-day analytics
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics as surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' with 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' and generation (assignment_generation.py) already turns a worksheet/topic into a verified problem set - but there's no described one-click bridge from a class-wide missed-concept signal straight to an assignable reteach set. Today reteach appears to route through the same manual generation flow rather than being seeded from the specific concept the analytics already identified.
proposal.change: On the teacher-day/class-analytics view, when a concept is flagged as broadly missed, add a 'Generate reteach set' action that pre-seeds assignment_generation.py with that exact concept (and the class's specific error pattern) so the teacher gets a ready-to-review, targeted problem set in one click instead of starting a generation from scratch.

proposal.title: Stop using the AA-Large-only muted text color below 18px on marketing and demo pages
proposal.rationale: Color-contrast is the single most common detector hit in this run, appearing on nearly every public surface with high element counts (13 on every demo.* page, 10 each on subjects_physics/chemistry/students, 7 on landing, 6 on demo, 5 on subjects_math). The design system already documents the boundary and it's being crossed: web/src/app/globals.css:42-47 states `--color-text-muted: #7D7669` is 'AA-Large only, intended for ≥18px labels and small caps', with `--color-text-secondary: #5C554C` as the AA-at-14px alternative — and demo/src/index.css:24-25 documents the identical pair (`--muted`/`--muted-2`). proposal.change: Audit `text-muted`/`--color-text-muted` (web) and `--muted-2` (demo) usages on the flagged pages (web/src/app/(marketing or public) pages for landing/demo/for-districts/subjects/students, and demo/src/index.css consumers) and swap any usage on text rendered below 18px to `text-secondary`/`--muted`, reserving the AA-Large color for genuinely large labels/small-caps per the existing code comment.

proposal.title: Add a one-click 'assign the fix' action from a surfaced weak-spot/concept gap
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes the teacher-day loop as ending with 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set' and weak-spots surfacing recurring errors, but the concrete inventory (section 4) lists grade review, analytics, and per-assignment practice as separate surfaces with no described one-click bridge from 'this concept is slipping class-wide' directly to assigning a targeted practice set on it.
proposal.change: On the teacher analytics/class-insight view, add an action next to each surfaced struggling-concept or weak-spot cluster that generates and assigns a small targeted practice set for just the affected students, closing the reteach loop without the teacher manually building an assignment.

proposal.title: Show students why a submission was flagged for the understanding check
proposal.rationale: Product context states integrity 'raises scrutiny, never auto-flags' and the check is a teacher-facing signal (badges/reasoning), but the feature map's student-facing surfaces (grades, homework detail) don't mention the student seeing any explanation of why they were asked to explain their work — today the understanding-check conversation itself is the only student-facing touchpoint.
proposal.change: After an integrity conversation completes, show the student a short plain-language summary of what the check was verifying (not a verdict/score), so the interaction reads as a normal part of doing homework rather than an opaque interrogation.

proposal.title: Auto-suggest a generation Focus from the class's current weak spots
proposal.rationale: The landing page's own product screenshot shows 'Generate more questions' with a free-text 'Focus — tell the AI what to emphasize' field the teacher has to fill in themselves; weak-spots/quality data already exists per class (api/routes/weak_spots.py) but isn't wired into generation as a starting point.
proposal.change: When a teacher opens 'Generate more questions' for a section, pre-populate the Focus field with the class's top unresolved weak-spot/quality signal (e.g. 'X% of class missed signed-number arithmetic last week'), still editable before generating.

proposal.title: Generate a reteach mini-lesson from a flagged class concept, not just more practice reps
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md says teacher-day analytics already surfaces 'which concepts the class is missing' and promises 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' but the shipped feature map only lists practice-activity generation (more problems on the same concept) — there's no actual reteach explainer, so the 'reteach' half of the homework→grade→understand→reteach loop is still just assigning repetition.
proposal.change: Add a 'Generate reteach' action next to a flagged concept in the teacher analytics view that produces a short worked-example explainer (reusing the generation pipeline's answer-re-derivation/verification step) the teacher can review/edit and either present in class or push as a Learn-mode assignment.

proposal.title: Let students ask a scoped clarification chat about their own published grade
proposal.rationale: grading_ai.py produces a per-problem grade with a written justification ('receipt') that today is shown to the student read-only; the integrity understanding-check conversation only runs pre-grade, so once a grade posts there's no student-facing way to ask why they lost points.
proposal.change: Add a chat scoped strictly to the stored grading rationale for one submission (read-only against the grade itself — any actual correction still routes through the teacher) reachable from the student's grades view.

proposal.title: Generate a targeted reteach mini-set directly from a detected class concept gap
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics as surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' with 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' and generation today turns a worksheet/topic into a problem set — but there's no described one-click flow that takes a specific detected concept gap and generates a small, verified reteach set (short re-explanation + a few re-derived practice problems) aimed at that exact misconception, closing the loop's final 'reteach' step the way generation already closes 'assign.'
proposal.change: Add a 'Reteach this' action on a flagged concept-gap in the teacher analytics view that calls the existing generation pipeline (worksheet/topic -> verified problem set) with the gap's concept as the seed, producing a small answer-checked set the teacher can review and assign in one step.

proposal.title: Let a student flag a posted grade for teacher re-look with a one-line reason
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md is explicit that grading pre-fills the teacher's review and the teacher approves every grade before it posts, but describes no path for a student who's confused by an already-posted AI-drafted grade to ask a question about it — today the loop stops at grade -> understand (integrity check) for right-answer-without-understanding, but not for a student who thinks their partial-credit grade is wrong.
proposal.change: Add a 'Ask about this grade' action on the student's graded-problem view that posts a short note into the teacher's grade-review queue for that submission (no grade change, no messaging system — just a flagged re-look item), keeping the teacher as the sole approver.

proposal.title: Extend generation's independent answer re-derivation to physics and chemistry
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md §3 states Generation's core trust guarantee is that 'every answer [is] independently re-derived' before a teacher sees it, and the /subjects/physics marketing page (shots/web.public.subjects_physics.png) promises Veradic 'catches the unit errors, sign errors, and vector-component mistakes that trip up every physics student' — but §4 notes 'math is the full, mature subject; physics and chemistry are partial' and 'engine depth beyond math is not complete,' with no mention of unit/dimensional consistency checking in the generation pipeline itself.
proposal.change: In api/core/assignment_generation.py's verification step, add a units/dimensional-analysis check for physics and chemistry problems (alongside the existing numeric answer re-derivation) before a generated set reaches the teacher, so the same 'verified before it's trusted' guarantee math generation has also covers the errors the physics marketing page explicitly claims to catch.

proposal.title: Share a verified question bank across teachers of the same course within a school
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md §3/§4 describes a reusable question bank (api/models/question_bank.py) that teachers build/generate for their own course, but nothing lets a second teacher of the same course at the same institutional school discover or reuse a colleague's already-verified questions — today each teacher regenerates and hand-checks their own set from scratch, even when a parallel section's teacher already did that work this term.
proposal.change: Add a school-scoped 'shared with your school' visibility option on a question bank entry so a teacher teaching the same course can browse and pull in colleagues' already-verified questions instead of regenerating them, reusing the existing generation-verification pipeline rather than building a new one.

proposal.title: Show students the AI's per-problem grade justification after teacher approval
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes grading as producing a per-problem grade with a written justification ('receipt') that pre-fills the teacher's review page, but the student-side feature map only lists 'grades' without describing whether that justification is ever shown to the student — likely they see just a score, missing the value of the AI's actual reasoning about where points were lost.
proposal.change: On the student assignment/grades view, surface the teacher-approved per-problem justification text (the same receipt already generated for the teacher) instead of just the numeric grade, so a student can see why they lost points on a specific step.

proposal.title: Auto-draft a short reteach explainer for the class's most-missed concept

proposal.change: When teacher-day analytics surface the class's top missed concept, add a one-click 'Draft a reteach note' action that generates a short (one paragraph + one worked example) explainer for that concept, verified the same way generated problems are, for the teacher to review and share.

proposal.title: Show students a short reflection summary after their understanding-check conversation
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes the integrity understanding-check emitting badges/confidence/reasoning and a stored transcript that the teacher reviews, but nothing is surfaced back to the student — per the feature map, the 'understand' step in the loop currently dead-ends at the teacher's grade-review page rather than closing the loop for the student's own learning.
proposal.change: After a submission's understanding-check has been reviewed/approved by the teacher, show the student a short plain-language reflection — what they explained well vs. where their explanation was thin — with a one-tap link into Practice on that concept.

proposal.title: One-click generate a targeted reteach set from a detected class-wide concept gap
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' (api/routes/teacher_grades.py, teacher_practice_activity.py) and a separate Generation capability that turns a worksheet/topic into a verified problem set (api/core/assignment_generation.py) -- but the two aren't connected today: there's no path from 'the class is missing factoring' straight into a generated, verified reteach set for that exact concept.

proposal.title: Let students revisit their own understanding-check conversation as a study artifact

proposal.title: Give students a longitudinal view of their own understanding-check history
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes Weak Spots as surfacing 'a student's recurring error patterns to review' and the integrity check as emitting 'per-problem badges/confidence/reasoning' per submission, but there's no described view that shows a student their own understanding-check trend over time (e.g. improving vs. still guessing on a topic) — today that signal is teacher-facing (grade review) or per-submission, not aggregated for the student's own self-awareness.

proposal.title: Surface the recurring student explanations behind a missed concept, not just the concept name
proposal.rationale: Every integrity understanding-check turn is already stored for audit (integrity_check.py), and teacher-day analytics already rank which concepts a class is missing, but that view is a concept label + count, not the qualitative 'why' students are stuck. A gap between data already captured and insight already shown to the teacher.

proposal.title: Auto-draft a targeted mini re-teach when the integrity check flags a misconception
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes the integrity check as emitting per-problem badges/reasoning for the teacher, and teacher-day analytics giving 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set' — but that path today is a generic practice generator, not something informed by the specific misconception the understanding-check conversation just surfaced. proposal.title: Let a student ask a follow-up question on their grading receipt
proposal.rationale: Grading (grading_ai.py) produces a per-problem receipt explaining the score, and integrity's understanding-check chat only runs before a grade is finalized. Per the feature map there's no channel for a student to ask 'why' about a specific point deduction after the fact — Learn/tutor chat is for solving new problems, not re-litigating a posted grade.
proposal.change: Add a small 'Explain this' affordance on each graded problem's receipt that opens a bounded, single-turn AI chat scoped to that problem's grade and rubric (guides the student to understand the deduction, doesn't change the score or give new answers) — teacher still sees the exchange, consistent with 'nothing auto-posts, everything is visible.'

proposal.title: Add a one-click 'assign practice' action on a flagged class-wide weak spot
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes generation as topic/worksheet-driven and weak-spots/practice as separately student-initiated or per-assignment; there's no stated action that turns a teacher-day struggle signal directly into an assigned practice set in one step, even though teacher-day's stated value prop is a 'path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set.'
proposal.change: On the teacher-day to-do list, add a one-click 'assign practice' action next to a flagged concept-gap signal that pre-fills the generation flow with that concept and the affected students, closing the loop from 'who's slipping' to 'reteach' without a separate manual trip to question bank/generation.

proposal.title: Add a cross-section concept-mastery rollup for teachers with multiple sections

proposal.title: Generate a whole-class reteach mini-lesson, not just more practice problems

proposal.title: Scaffold practice difficulty from a student's weak-spot signal
proposal.rationale: Practice (api/core/practice.py) generates unlimited similar problems from a seed/assignment, and Weak Spots (api/routes/weak_spots.py) already tracks a student's recurring error patterns — but the two aren't connected to vary difficulty.
